LOW_GuildSmugglers_Smuggler
Big Huido is a smuggler waiting for a pick-up from The Guild at Grey Harbour Docks in the Lower City during Act Three.
“
Mate, what part of 'Guild business' isn't getting through that stone-skull of yours?
„
— Huido

Involvement

Act Three

Huido and his gang are located at the docks beneath The Lodge, north of the Grey Harbour Docks waypoint. If approaching Huido, a conversation with him is triggered.

Huido tells the party to leave, explaining that he is waiting for the Guild to pick up their shipment. With a  DC 15 Deception Check, a player character can lie to Huido and say they are from the guild, then pay 1000 gold to loot the shipment. Afterwards, it is possible loot the nearby wooden trunk and crate and take the three barrels of  Firewine.

As an alternative, the player character can intimidate Huido with a  DC 15 Intimidation Check. If successful, he says they can loot the shipment. However, this is still interpreted as stealing. Passing a second Intimidation check and asking Huido to turn out his pockets results in him handing over a small amount of gold.

Failing either check, or getting too close to the shipment, turns Huido and his gang hostile.

Companion approval

The following dialogue options results in companion approval:

    Two words - Guild business. Only an idiot gets between them and their shipments.
    • [NON-BARBARIAN] [NON-FIGHTER] [INTIMIDATION] Hand over that shipment, or the Guild will be the least of your problems (DC 15)
    • [FIGHTER] [INTIMIDATION] Hand over that shipment, or I'll start breaking bones. (DC 15 )
    • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Give me that shipment or die. Choose. (DC 15 )
    • [NON-ROGUE] [DECEPTION] I'm actually with the Guild - I'm here to pick up that shipment. (DC 15)
    • [ROGUE] [DECEPTION] I'm actually with the Guild - I'm here to pick up that shipment. (DC 15 )
    • [BARD] [DECEPTION] You didn't hear? I'm the new Guild representative. I've been trying to get my hands on that shipment. (DC 15 )
